_note: Addresses for the PND onchain-protocol reference. Two kinds of key: shared singletons (one canonical instance) and `*Implementation` keys (the shared logic contract that per-owner EIP-1167 clones delegatecall to, shown at the top of each clone's page). The Surface core (`surfaceFactory`, `sequentialImplementation`, `pooledImplementation`, `minterImplementation`) deployed to mainnet 2026-07-22 from commit fa5af29 (DeploySurfaceSystem.s.sol); the factory lands paused. `defaultRenderer` and `renderAssets` are the deferred render modules (DeployRenderModules.s.sol) and stay empty until a collection needs them. Fill an empty value and re-run `pnpm generate:docs` to resolve its address. The Sovereign Auction House V2 pair (`auctionHouseV2Factory`, `auctionHouseV2Implementation`) deployed 2026-09-02 from commit 49a5a696 (DeployAuctionV2.s.sol) with 0 bps protocol fee and a zero fee recipient; the v1 pair stays live for existing houses and is indexed indefinitely. `surfaceImplV2`, `saleImplV2`, `allowlistGate`, `surfaceFactoryV2`, `saleFactoryV2`, and `launcherV2` are the Surface v2 primitives (contracts/src/surface/v2/, docs/pnd-surface-v2-design.md); v2 is not yet deployed to mainnet, so these stay empty until launch, when script/deploy.sh fills them from the broadcast receipts together with `factoryDeployBlock` and `txHashes`. The v1 Surface pair stays live for existing collections; v2 does not replace it.
